variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: M855
variants.info:
Uses M855 instead of Duplex rounds. More accurate than the base ammo!
Deals good damage to the torso and head, high bullet speed, good penetration and lower recoil but fires slow and not so good at dealing limb damage!

variants.name: Phase-1 Duplex
variants.info:
Uses experimental Phase-1 Duplex rounds, it's made of a tungsten core which has more penetration than your base ammo, but at the cost of limb and headshot damage, and your bullet speed!
Comes with a 20rd magazine improving your reload, walk and handling speed!
